verdict.rationale: IRCC's public work-permit page links to a first-party "Check your application status" feature, so the product itself offers case-status lookup. The evidence is only that single link label, and it does not describe how the lookup works or what it shows. The public processing-times checker gives backward-looking estimates by application type, not the status of a specific filing, so it is adjacent and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of how the status lookup works (access method, account or GCKey requirement, what status details are shown), coverage for founder or Start-up Visa applications specifically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
